internal_conflicts.note: Explicit supersession by the same sender: Nikos's Message 4 (2026-07-23) states the date is locked at 14 Φεβρουαρίου following the board meeting and calls it οριστικό, replacing the 31 Ιανουαρίου request in his Message 2 (2026-07-19). extraction_notes: Message 2 refers to an earlier launch plan of March ("μεγάλη αλλαγή από τον Μάρτιο") with no exact date; not extracted as a timeline item. It is the "αρχικό πλάνο" mentioned in Message 4.
Message 3 (Eleni, agency side) states that 31/1 is very tight and that a new photo shoot would not fit safely; this is an agency assessment, not client evidence, and is not extracted.
